messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] high_queue_growth detected on gpu-pool-prod-west (threshold=90%) — autoscaler throttle observed. ticket=INC-325111: paging oncall

alice: ack — I'm on it. seeing a spike in gen-llm queues, routing 503->429 for a subset. starting initial triage.

ben: grabbing logs from scheduler and autoscaler. can you confirm which pool? gpu-pool-prod-west?

alice: yes. queue size jumped from ~120 -> ~1400 in 3m for p100/mig-7g workloads, CPU copy paths backed up.

carla: adding context — recent deploy last night changed MIG profiles (added more 7g slices), but binpack defaults stayed tight. possible fragmentation + insufficient scale target.

devon: timeline: autoscaler tried to request new nodes but cloud quota hit one region soft-limit + placement failed due to fragmented MIG sizes. logs: "no compatible nodes for pod request: required_mig=7g, available_slices=1,2"

ben: pasting relevant snippet:
```
E0325 14:05:12 scheduler.go:412] pod "serve-gen-abc" failed placement: required_mig:7g, candidate_nodes:[node-12(3x1g), node-14(2x2g)], reason: incompatible-slice
Autoscaler: request throttled: scale_limit_reached
```

maya: support we have customers seeing long tail latency and a handful of downstream 429s. CS queue heating up. tagging priority accounts now.

zhang: which customers affected? any enterprise SLA hits?

maya: two customers showing increased error rate: AcmePayments (>=1% 429s last 10m) and NoteFlow (retry storms). Noticed surge coincident with big batch ingest.

alice: mitigation plan attempt 1: temporarily reroute lower-priority traffic to cached responses and smaller model variants, and enable emergency-burst policy to let autoscaler exceed soft cap by +2 nodes. Need infra ok.

ben: we can't exceed because cloud quota blocked. requesting emergency quota bump — already on the phone with cloud support. meanwhile we can do: 1) repack MIG allocations to consolidate free slices 2) allow mixed-mig placement for non-sensitive tenants

devon: I can push a quick repack job that will attempt binpack consolidation across nodes. It'll cordon some nodes briefly and drain. Risk: short-lived extra latency for draining pods. ETA ~7m to start.

carla: preferred: run repack on one AZ at a time and keep canary routers open. also we should throttle background batch jobs by 50% to reduce queue pressure — @maya please flag batch teams.

maya: flagged batch, they acknowledged; throttling started (50%).

raj: handed over from alice — I'm taking over incident until stable. Starting repack now. command used:
```
internal-repack --pool gpu-pool-prod-west --mode aggressive --concurrency 2
```

ben: watching scheduler logs. repack started, consolidating 18 pods -> 9 nodes. seeing some MIG reassigns.

carla: observed one node that couldn't drain due to long-lived job: torch-exporter job. devon can you kill those or migrate?

devon: killing torch-exporter on node-87 now and restarting elsewhere.

ben: autoscaler now able to place 6 new pods after repack. cloud quota bump still pending but not required yet. queue decreasing: 1400 -> 420 in 6m.

alice: good progress. switching high-latency routes to smaller model v2-small for 20% of traffic to reduce token cost. applying rollout: `route-config set /generate model=v2-small percent=20`

maya: CS updated: AcmePayments seeing errors down from 1%->0.1% after reroute. Noted residual retries.

zhang: collecting RRT/429 impact numbers for customer incident report. please save any relevant logs and tag with INC-325111.

carla: post-mitigation checks: 1) no unmatched stranded MIG slices detected after repack 2) reserved pools show 5 spare slices available 3) autoscaler metrics normalizing.

ben: followups: we need an autoscaler circuit-breaker to avoid "throttle->queue growth" feedback, and a graceful degrade path for MIG-incompatible pods (fallback to mixed-slice). filing infra ticket.

devon: ML followups: add model-variant fallback that uses cpu-gpu hybrid nodes for short tail when MIG placement fails. Also evaluate making 3g slices default for latency-sensitive routes.

raj: incident moving to monitoring stage. leaving a watch rotation for next 2 hours. if queues re-spike, escalate to SRE pager.

alice: big thanks everyone — remediation successful for now. we should do a blameless postmortem tomorrow.

carla: creating postmortem draft: ACTIONS so far:
- emergency repack tool run (raj)
- background batch throttle (maya)
- temp reroute to v2-small (alice/devon)
- cloud quota request submitted (ben)

ben: assigning infra tickets: INFRA-592 (autoscaler CB), INFRA-593 (quota check automation), INFRA-594 (binpack heuristics for MIG).

maya: CS notif: preparing customer summary for AcmePayments and NoteFlow, will send draft to stakeholders in 30m.

incident-bot: [UPDATE] INC-325111 status -> mitigated (monitoring).

alice: marking thread resolved but keep logs attached to the incident.

carla: postmortem owners: ben, devon. schedule 1hr review tomorrow 11:00 PT.

raj: thanks all. :thumbsup:
